title: Mughal provincial administration: more officials and links

boxes.title: Added detail on known posts
items: Subedar also called ==**sipahsalar / nazim**==; enforced imperial decrees
Bakhshi: also **news reports**; Kotwal: **markets**, watch on newcomers
Bitikchi: records of land, crops, assessment; ==assistant to the amalguzar==
Potdar also **fotedar / khazandar**; Muqaddam also **patel**, collected revenue

boxes.title: Local conflicts (jagirdari crisis)
steps: Zamindars keep a ==hereditary share== of jama

boxes.title: Comparisons & AP
items: British **district collector**: ==revenue + magisterial + police== in one hand; Mughals kept them apart
Zamindars: local, helped **police** and collection; villages largely ==self-governing==
**Northern Circars** zamindars date from the ==Qutb Shahi== era
